caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a metal horse bit or bridle component. The object is primarily composed of metal parts colored in shades of brown and dark gray. It features two curved, ornate side pieces with detailed, scrolling designs and oval-shaped silver or reflective insets. There are two rings at the top of the piece for attachments and two curved bars at the bottom forming a mouthpiece and a shank. Two sections near the top are wrapped in narrow, light brown bands that appear to be leather or some similar material. The object has a symmetrical design and is positioned centrally against a plain, light beige or off-white background, with no other objects present. The drawing is detailed and shaded to show depth and dimension. In the bottom right corner, there is a small printed name: “FRANK C. BARONE.”
title: Bit with Curb
